subject: Pilot impact recap + 15-min advocacy / brief reference
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@tiltplatform.com>, Rajiv Kapoor <rajiv.kapoor@tiltplatform.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot impact recap + 15-min advocacy / brief reference

Hi Laura & Rajiv,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the three-week POC — it was a pleasure working with your ML and infra teams. I wanted to send a very short recap (attached) of the outcomes we observed and ask two quick favors if you're willing: a 15-minute call to be a brief reference, and a 1-2 sentence quote we can use in a one-pager.

Key pilot highlights (TL;DR):
- Inference latency: 78ms median per request at 512-token context (vs. 210ms baseline)
- Cost reduction: ~41% lower per-1000-token cost using our batching + KV-cache settings
- Throughput: consistent 1.6k requests/min sustained during peak tests
- Error/timeout rate: <0.2% across 48h stress window

Attachments: Tilt_Pilot_Summary_20280621.pdf (full metrics + graphs), tilt_roi_calc.xlsx (sensitive internal calc — redacted in public excerpt).

If you’re open to this, would you prefer: (A) a 15-minute reference call with me + Aditya next week, or (B) a quick 2-line quote via email we can publish with your approval? We’d keep the ask very light and share the draft before anything goes live.

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 6/27 10:00-10:15, Wed 6/28 15:00-15:15, Thu 6/29 11:30-11:45 — but we’re flexible to match your schedule.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: 415-555-0198
